title: Better Buy: Fortinet or Palo Alto Networks? | FTNT Stock vs. PANW Stock
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Head-to-head comparison of Fortinet and Palo Alto Networks as rogue-AI headlines pull cybersecurity demand and both stocks are up over 100% in 2026. Parkevtate compares a decade of revenue, operating profitability and returns on capital: Palo Alto's revenue 10x'd to $11.5B and Fortinet's to $7.5B, but profitability diverged — Fortinet's operating margin hit a record 32.3% (~100% ROIC, near the best of any company he follows) while Palo Alto's collapsed to 5.4% (ROIC 1.8%). His DCFs still say both are expensive: FTNT fair value $97 versus ~$176 (~45% overvalued) and PANW fair value $164 (~50% overvalued). Verdict: delay buying BOTH until prices are more attractive; if forced to pick one today, FTNT — the relative winner on margins, ROIC and free cash flow. Calls: FTNT CONDITIONAL_BUY (a relative-preference stance flip from his Oct 3 HOLD — not a price-target call, he still says wait for a cheaper price), PANW AVOID (first call on record; no prior stance, so not a flip).

calls.thesis: Picks FTNT over PANW if forced to buy today — record 32.3% op margin, ~100% ROIC — but says DELAY buying both until cheaper (~45% overvalued).
calls.base: Revenue accelerating with margins at record highs; better productivity story than PANW.
calls.bear: Both names up >100% in 2026 and trading near their most expensive forward P/E in years.
